name: contemporary_2026_diagnostic
purpose: Evaluation only; never use for fitting, threshold selection, or feature selection.
limitations: Small hand-curated diagnostic sample, not a representative benchmark.
Real labels denote claims published by an identified official source and are not independent verification of every underlying assertion.
False labels are based on the linked fact-check articles.
Items are short claims rather than full articles.

records.text: BHASHINI and the Indian Institute of Science developed a text-to-speech model for the Sourashtra language.
India's vice president commissioned the Indian Navy's first indigenous multi-purpose vessel, INS Samarthak, at Karwar.
The Narcotics Control Bureau in Jodhpur seized 2.3 kilograms of controlled pharmaceutical tablets and apprehended one person.
IIT Jodhpur reported work on robotic heart scans and artificial-intelligence-assisted fracture detection.
Mormugao Port became India's first government autonomous body to secure a private 5G CNPN licence.
India's defence ministry signed contracts worth 4,106 crore rupees for a GSAT-7C communications satellite and Varunastra torpedoes.
The prime minister inaugurated five development projects valued at about 3,350 crore rupees in Ladakh.
The Indian Navy commissioned the indigenous anti-submarine warfare shallow-water craft INS Mangrol.
India's Ministry of Textiles organized workshops about cybersecurity, secure digital disposal and electronic-waste awareness.
India and Mali commemorated World Cotton Day at United Nations headquarters in New York.
Any ballot marked by a poll worker will be disqualified in the 2026 United States midterm elections.
Texas Senate candidate James Talarico secretly spent time in an Ohio mental-health facility.
The Biden administration revoked White House press passes from more than 400 journalists.
The United States and Venezuela together hold more than 60 percent of the world's oil reserves.
Photographs show New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani as a child together with Jeffrey Epstein.
A video of uniformed men dragging a woman shows forced military conscription in Ukraine.
A circulating photograph genuinely shows a fatal tiger attack at a wildlife park.
All clips in a viral compilation genuinely show Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy belly dancing.
A video shows a real missile strike causing a passenger aircraft to explode at Riyadh international airport.
Bill Gates said that water shortages will kill one billion people by 2027.
